column1: # The quiz's slips: what build/quiz.py finds in what the site shows and is not
# yet mended in data/quiz/ (data/quiz/README.md).  The study edition's 63 came
# over with its quiz on 2026-11-22, and went the same day: 25 misspellings, the
# four dates of id 703 left in the British order, the "~" of id 479 and the
# question asked twice (750, as 749) mended, and the 23 metric units and 9
# times on the 24-hour clock kept, no slips since (Tigran: "Keep metric units
# and 24h times and fix the rest").  The build requires exactly what is listed:
# a new slip fails, and so does one mended and still listed here.  `note` names
# the question's file, for finding it; the build reads only kind, id and what.
